stem.text: Cell structures can be isolated by centrifuging the cells in a sucrose density gradient. This breaks up the cells and separates the cell structures into fractions.
The diagram shows the positions of some of these fractions in a sucrose density gradient.

stem.alt: Tall tube with four grey bands at different heights, labelled fraction 1 to fraction 4, with a bracket marked sucrose density gradient along the tube.

stem.text: Which fractions contain cell structures that carry out protein synthesis?
